London Hatfield Summer School offers the perfect blend of learning, travel, and relaxation, with options to suit every interest. You can join a chaperoned group departure or, if you prefer, travel independently.

Activities: Sports tournaments, parties, talent shows, themed evenings, arts & crafts
Excursions: St Albans, Brighton, Oxford, Cambridge, London
Networking: Connect with students from around the world and learn from leading lecturers
These are the standard activities that all participants of the summer school will have the opportunity to attend without any extra cost.
